Bug_Details:
This annotation has incompatible modifiers as specified by its @IncompatibleModifiers annotation The @IncompatibleModifiers annotation declares that the target annotation is
incompatible with a set of provided modifiers. This check ensures that all
annotations respect their @IncompatibleModifiers specifications.
Bug_Explanation: The annotation @IncompatibleExample is applied to a method with incompatible modifiers due to the @IncompatibleModifiers rule. This demonstrates the bug by allowing the annotation to be mistakenly placed on a method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' calls the 'showBug' method annotated with '@IncompatibleExample'. This triggers the 'IncompatibleModifiers' bug because the annotation is applied to a method with incompatible modifiers, as specified by its @IncompatibleModifiers annotation.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that all tests passed successfully without errors. There is no evidence in the test results to confirm that the bug was triggered.
